visualSystem.background: high-key white with restrained lavender edge light; black only for brand punctuation
visualSystem.typography: Geist 850–900, tight tracking, editorial all-caps at selected accents
visualSystem.camera: perspective macro inspection of one persistent product surface
visualSystem.hierarchy: the selected component is the subject; no recurring title/header system

motionRules: Large camera translations: 0.45–0.8s; begin fast, settle briefly, hold only for reading.
Component arrivals: 0.3–0.55s with 0.07–0.12s overlap; preserve a shared destination.
Letters focus over 0.31s, stagger 14ms, blur clears as displacement decelerates.
Velocity-linked motion blur sampled across a 144-degree shutter; no constant blur during holds.
Cursor arrives before its consequence; control changes before the visible result.
Use the same page and component data at overview and macro scale.
No autonomous idle drift; movement must direct attention, manipulate content or hand off a scene.
Retain the actual DOM object from motion to final layout, with identity transform at its destination.
Nest cursors and controls under the same camera transform; use config/interactions.json for down, up and result ordering.
Demonstrate one property on one persistent subject; surrounding photographs do not change during a background-color edit.
Keep the layout control and affected form visible together until the transformation is readable.
